hook_options: RBI set ₹15,009/unit redemption for 2019-20 SGB—here's what changes for your April 15 exit.
From April 2026, tax changes will affect SGB exits—premature redemptions may not be tax-free.
Three fast scenarios: online issue, secondary market, and hold-to-maturity—exact numbers and tax implications.
final_script: If you hold RBI Sovereign Gold Bonds 2019-20 Series V, the RBI has scheduled a premature redemption on April 15, 2026. The fixed redemption price is ₹15,009 per unit, derived from the three-day IBJA average before redemption. You also earned 2.5% fixed interest per year on the initial investment, paid semi-annually. Let’s run three quick scenarios. Scenario 1: online original issue. Suppose you bought 1 unit online at about ₹3,738. Redemption at ₹15,009 per unit yields a pre-tax gain of ₹11,271 per unit, plus accrued interest for the holding period. Scenario 2: secondary-market purchase. If you bought Series V in the secondary market around ₹3,800 and redeem on April 15, 2026, your gross gain looks similar, but tax depends on whether you’re held to maturity under the new regime. Scenario 3: hold-to-maturity. Under Budget 2026 rules, tax-exemption on SGB redemptions is restricted; from April 1, 2026, exiting prematurely may be taxable unless held to maturity. Treasuries and portfolios should adjust cash flow accordingly. Takeaway: verify your exact tranche and window with your bank, NSDL/CDSL, or RBI Retail Direct; compare ₹15,009 to current gold prices, and decide your exit under the new tax regime. If you have other SGBs, note that redemption dates differ; don’t assume all share the same window. Action: check your tranche details and plan your exit now.

final_script:
Agar aapke paas SGB 2019-20 Series V hai,
15 April 2026 ko sirf redemption nahi ho raha,
aapka tax aur cash-flow decision ho raha hai.

RBI ne is tranche ka premature redemption price fix kiya hai,
15,009 rupaye per unit.
Ek unit matlab 1 gram gold.

Ab simple language mein samjho.
Maan lo aapne ek unit online issue par liya tha,
lagbhag 3,738 mein.
Ab exit 15,009 par ho raha hai.
Matlab around 11,271 ka capital gain per unit,
aur upar se 2.5% annual interest alag mila hoga holding period mein.

Sunne mein mast lag raha hai.
Par ek warning hai.
1 April 2026 ke baad rule change ho chuka hai.
Har redemption tax-free nahi maana jayega.
Agar aap original subscriber ho aur maturity tak hold kiya hai,
tabhi exemption ka benefit relevant ho sakta hai.
Premature redemption par tax lag sakta hai.

Dusra scene samjho.
Agar aapne yeh SGB secondary market se kharida tha,
to gross profit dekh ke khush mat ho.
After-tax profit dekho.
Paper pe 15,009 dikhega,
account mein real winner wahi hai jo tax ke baad number samjhe.

Teesri baat, business owners ke liye important.
Agar aap personal ya company treasury mein SGB rakhte ho,
isse aane wala cash idle mat chhodna.
Pehle decide karo,
yeh paisa emergency buffer mein jayega,
debt reduce karega,
ya portfolio rebalance hoga.

Bas ek galti mat karna.
Saare SGBs ki date same maan lena.
Apna exact tranche,
window,
and holding type check karo.

Aaj hi bank, depository, ya RBI details verify karo,
aur after-tax gain nikaalo.
Profit wahi hota hai jo pocket mein bache.
